scientific_assessment.reason: Under field-wide evidence both nonlinear families represent the interaction structure that a linear policy cannot, and under immediate visibility this raises the productive share of entrants in both interaction geometries. Entry decisions are made before an agent's own outcome is public, so that effect is out of sample. Under four-step failure delay every agent enters in every field arm, so no policy can change who enters. The registered policy Brier includes each agent's own public outcome, which makes it mostly in sample; trees memorize best, so the registered tree dominance is not evidence about generalization. Under neighbor evidence, about four events per agent, every feature learner is worse than the fixed prior in interaction worlds.
